name: s8-stopout-contention
title: Stop-out under SL load: 450 x 0.01 vIDX with SL levels on 49990001, three accounts sized to stop out at 0.7 / 1.0 / 1.3 % (three stop-out episodes per run), one ramp through all

steps.text: The before / after match-run of Part A (owner 2026-10-27): the same scenario on the old engine and on the new one. The SL levels sit 0.5 % .. 1.5 % below the open, so the ramp crosses about 90 of them per tick. Three accounts are sized to stop out INSIDE that burst, at 0.7 %, 1.0 % and 1.3 % (owner 2026-10-27: three stop-out episodes per run, not one, so the after-run's stop-out delay p95 has more than a single sample; run it several times for more). Each wipe-out stays beyond its stop-out: 1:200 at 0.95 %, 1:100 at 1.5 %, 1:50 at 2.3 %; a stop-out late enough to pass it is the NBP write-off the old engine risks. Read the result with tools/shadow-bot/sql/stopout-contention-capture.sql.
